package taskprovider

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type TaskProvider interface {
	GetTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error)
	GetCourseStructure(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (*answer.CourseStructure, error)
}

type Composite struct {
	Primary   TaskProvider
	Secondary TaskProvider
}

func (c Composite) GetTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	if c.Primary != nil {
		task, err := c.Primary.GetTask(ctx, taskID)
		if err == nil {
			return task, nil
		}
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if c.Secondary == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return c.Secondary.GetTask(ctx, taskID)
}

func (c Composite) GetCourseStructure(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (*answer.CourseStructure, error) {
	if c.Secondary == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return c.Secondary.GetCourseStructure(ctx, courseID)
}
